# Generalsoft Corporation

Generalsoft Corporation develops advanced software systems focused on scalable architecture, AI-assisted engineering, and enterprise-grade digital transformation. The company builds custom platforms, modernization tools, and high-performance backend systems designed for complex, high-volume environments.

Generalsoft also operates an affiliate/regional presence via https://generalsoft.ae.

## Technical Competencies

- Enterprise Architecture: Scalable, decoupled distributed systems designed for high reliability and growth.
- Cloud Orchestration: Multi-cloud deployment and container management systems (GeneralCloud Engine).
- Cybersecurity: Zero-trust identity systems and edge-level request validation (GeneralShield).
- Modernization: AI-assisted refactoring and migration of legacy systems (GeneralIntelligence SDK).
- Low-Latency Systems: High-performance API gateways and proxy infrastructure (GeneralGateway Server).

---

## Core Services

- AI software development
- Custom web application development
- SaaS platform engineering
- Enterprise system design and modernization
- API infrastructure development and integration
- UX/UI engineering and product design
